title: Stale claude-settings branches are archived or deleted only after an unmerged-commit check
why: Your GitHub audit, Oct 27 23:01 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh211VfMPE9qfHmdrFTC9vz7X): 70 branches, about 15 older than 14 days, including 4 claude/held-* branches, merge-ci-savings, and batch-oct27y and batch-oct27z whose PRs are closed.
note: Debt: some may hold the only copy of work. The lane lists each branch older than 14 days with its commits not on main; a branch with none is deleted; a branch with some is pushed to archive/<branch> (rule shared-trees-archive-then-delete) and then deleted, and the list goes in the batch report. c44 already removes a lane's branch at merge; this is the backlog from before it, plus closed-PR branches c44 does not reach. Needs no answer. Port: no; claude-settings only. Placed ahead of c47 (triage, Oct 28): after c44, its upkeep twin. Done in the cloud Oct 28: 15 of 77 branches are older than 14 days, each with 1 to 5 commits not on main, so each was pushed to archive/<branch> (15 of 15 verified equal). The cloud proxy refuses deletes (403). The deletes ran on shiv's Mac (item 39, done Oct 28 13:22 CDT; orchestrator verified 13:24 CDT): all 15 claude-settings branches are gone, each archive/<branch> copy stays, and the child-repo lane branches (home, degen, q_max, banchi, ios-adblock) are gone too.
